narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Marked-Up Đề Cương"**

Every case is a page of photocopied revision notes. The page is cool grey xerox paper with a faint toner speckle, printed in toner black with one-pixel rules and no corners anywhere. Nothing floats, glows or sits in a card: hierarchy comes from type scale and weight alone, and structure comes from rules drawn across the column.

The student's own marks are the only colour. Fluorescent yellow highlighter marks the newest clue and the active mode; pink highlighter and a blue ballpoint strike mark a wrong guess; green highlighter marks the solved answer; blue ballpoint handwriting carries everything the player writes (guesses, their own stats). A finished page reads as a sheet the student has worked through, which is what gets shared.

The system rejects the soft-card SaaS dashboard it replaced: no rounded panels, icon tiles, gradients-as-decoration or hero illustration.
keyCharacteristics: Xerox paper ground with SVG fractal-noise speckle, toner ink, zero radius everywhere.
Hierarchy by a heavy grotesque at weight 900 with tight tracking, never by boxes.
One-pixel rules: full toner for section heads, 25% toner for row dividers, dashed for unopened clue slots.
Colour appears only as marker or pen marks on text, never as a surface fill.
Two hands: printed (Be Vietnam Pro) for the page, ballpoint (Patrick Hand) for the player.

rules.name: The Marks-Not-Fills Rule
rules.body: Highlighter and pen colours are only ever drawn across text as bands, strokes or handwriting. No panel, tile, chip or button is filled with them.

rules.name: The One Highlight Rule
rules.body: Yellow sits on the latest clue only; older clues drop the mark when a new one opens. The active mode word is the only other yellow on the page.

rules.name: The Type-Is-The-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy changes by size and weight, not by containers. A new section gets a bold label over a toner rule, never a box.

rules.name: The Two Hands Rule
rules.body: Print is the page; handwriting is the player. Patrick Hand is used only for text the player produced or earned (guesses, their stats), never for instructions or headings.

rules.name: The One Loose Sheet Rule
rules.body: The dialog is the only lifted object. Nothing on the page carries a shadow.

dos: **Do** keep every corner at 0px and draw structure with 1px rules (toner for heads, 25% toner for rows).
**Do** apply yellow, pink and green as chisel-edged bands behind text, with `box-decoration-break: clone` so marks wrap per line.
**Do** set anything the player wrote in Patrick Hand, ballpoint blue (#2340a0).
**Do** carry hierarchy with Be Vietnam Pro at 900 and -0.04em tracking for headings, balanced wrap on titles.
**Do** keep the speckled xerox paper (#ecece7) as the only page ground, including the dialog.
**Do** make every reveal animation instant under reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** use rounded panels, cards, icon tiles, decorative gradients or hero illustration.
**Don't** fill any surface or button with a highlighter or pen colour.
**Don't** put more than one yellow clue mark on the page at once.
**Don't** add shadows to anything on the page; only the dialog lifts.
**Don't** use Patrick Hand for instructions, headings or printed content.
